description_en: Retrieves the download URL for X.509 certificates of devices that are registered in bulk
description_zh: 获取批量注册设备的X.509证书下载链接
name: QueryCertUrlByApplyId

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the invoke failed.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The application batch ID to query. You can view the application batch ID in the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69514.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69473.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的申请批次ID。申请批次ID可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69514.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69473.html接口返回结果中查看
parameters.name: apply_id

CertUrl.description_en: The download URL for the X.509 certificates of the batch of devices
CertUrl.description_zh: 该批次设备的X.509证书下载链接

Code.description_en: The fault code returned if the invoke failed. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the invoke failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identity generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the invoke is successful.
true: The invoke was successful.
false: The invoke failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
